dashboard_not_configured.title: Dashboard Not Configured
dashboard_not_configured.description:
The RBKC Parking Monitor dashboard is not configured. Add one of these options to your `configuration.yaml` and restart:

**Option 1 - Using Packages (Easiest):**
```yaml
{package_config}
```

**Option 2 - Direct Configuration:**
```yaml
{direct_config}
```

After adding either option, restart Home Assistant to see the dashboard in your sidebar.
